ColonyCouncil.DilemmaDef.label: a home at the old town

texts.li: [spouse] {A_nameDef}'s {RELATION} {RELATIVE} lives at {TOWN}, the town the colony was, and the two live apart. {A_nameDef} has asked the council to let {A_objective} go and live there with {RELATIVE}.
[child] {A_nameDef}'s {RELATION} {RELATIVE} lives at {TOWN}, the town the colony was, among {FACTION}. {A_nameDef} has asked the council whether to go and live there too.
[friend] {RELATIVE}, {A_nameDef}'s close friend, lives at {TOWN}, the town the colony was. {A_nameDef} has asked the council to let {A_objective} go and live there too.
{A_nameDef} has asked the council to let {A_objective} go and live at {TOWN}, the town the colony was, where {RELATIVE} lives now among {FACTION}.
[spouse] {A_nameDef} wants to live with {A_possessive} {RELATION} {RELATIVE} again, at {TOWN}, the town the colony was. {A_nameDef} has asked the council to let {A_objective} go.
[child] {A_nameDef}'s {RELATION} {RELATIVE} lives at {TOWN} among {FACTION}, and {A_nameDef} would rather be near. {A_nameDef} has asked the council to let {A_objective} go and live there.
[friend] {A_nameDef} misses {RELATIVE}, a close friend who lives at {TOWN} now, the town the colony was. {A_nameDef} has asked the council whether {A_objective} may go there too.
{A_nameDef} has asked the council for leave to go and live at {TOWN}, the town the colony was, to be near {RELATIVE}.

li.label: Let {A_nameDef} go to {RELATIVE} at {TOWN}
li.outcome: The colony saw {A_nameDef} to the gate with a full pack, and {A_nameDef} set off for {TOWN}, to {RELATIVE}, one of {FACTION} now.

li.label: Ask {A_nameDef} to stay
li.outcome: The council asked {A_nameDef} to stay, and {A_nameDef} said yes, trusting the council a little less for it. That night {A_nameDef} wrote a long letter to {RELATIVE} at {TOWN}.
